ward.summary: Bhandup, Powai and Kanjurmarg (ward S) used ₹74.9 lakh of its ₹95.0 lakh budget, or 79%, across 123 jobs, staying within budget. Repairs redone within 30 days were 32% against an expected 24%, which is worse than expected, and ₹22.2 lakh went on repairs that failed. Timeliness was in line with expectations at 50% on time versus 51%. Nine jobs are listed for review, and 16 jobs worth ₹9.6 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should fund its 32 open issues, costing ₹9.3 lakh, starting with Powai Adi Shankaracharya Marg. The remaining ₹20.1 lakh covers all of them.
